entries.title: Mark 3:1
segments: And He again entered into the synagogue. And a man was there who had a withered hand.

entries.title: Mark 3:2
segments: And they watched Him to see if He would heal him on the sabbath day, so that they might accuse Him.

entries.title: Mark 3:3
segments: And He said to the man who had the withered hand, Arise! Come into the middle.

entries.title: Mark 3:4
segments: And He said to them, [Is it] lawful to do good on the sabbath days, or to do evil? To save life, or to kill? But they were silent.

entries.title: Mark 3:5
segments: And looking around on them with anger, being grieved because of the hardness of their hearts, He said to the man, Stretch out your hand! And he stretched [it] out. And his hand was restored whole, like the other.

entries.title: Mark 3:6
segments: The Pharisees went out and immediately took counsel with the Herodians against Him, how they might destroy Him.

entries.title: Mark 3:7
segments: And Jesus withdrew to the sea with His disciples. And a great crowd from Galilee followed Him, and from Judea,

entries.title: Mark 3:8
segments: and from Jerusalem, and from Idumea, and [from] beyond Jordan, and those around Tyre and Sidon, a great throng came to him, having heard how much He was doing.

entries.title: Mark 3:9
segments: And He spoke to His disciples, so that a small boat should stay near to Him, because of the crowd, lest they should press on Him.

entries.title: Mark 3:10
segments: For He had healed many, so that they pressed on Him in order to touch Him, as many as had plagues.

entries.title: Mark 3:11
segments: And unclean spirits, when they saw Him, [they] fell down before Him and cried, saying, You are the Son of God!

entries.title: Mark 3:12
segments: And He strictly charged them that they should not make Him known.

entries.title: Mark 3:13
segments: And He went up into a mountain and called near those whom He would. And they came to Him.

entries.title: Mark 3:14
segments: And He ordained twelve, that they should be with Him, and that He might send them out to proclaim,

entries.title: Mark 3:15
segments: and to have authority to heal sicknesses, and to cast out demons.

entries.title: Mark 3:16
segments: And He put on Simon [the] name Peter.

entries.title: Mark 3:17
segments: And He put on James [the son] of Zebedee, and John the brother of James, [the] names Boanerges, which is, the Sons of Thunder.

entries.title: Mark 3:18
segments: And [He appointed] Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James [the son] of Alpheus, and Thaddeus, and Simon the Canaanite,

entries.title: Mark 3:19
segments: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him. And they went into a house.

entries.title: Mark 3:20
segments: And again a crowd came together, so that they could not even eat bread.

entries.title: Mark 3:21
segments: And hearing, those with Him went out to take hold [of] Him; for they said, He is insane.

entries.title: Mark 3:22
segments: And the scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, He has Beelzebub, and He casts out demons by the ruler of the demons.

entries.title: Mark 3:23
segments: And He called them and said to them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?

entries.title: Mark 3:24
segments: And if a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

entries.title: Mark 3:25
segments: And if a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

entries.title: Mark 3:26
segments: And if Satan rises up against himself, and is divided, he cannot stand, but has an end.

entries.title: Mark 3:27
segments: No one can enter into a strong one's house and plunder his goods, except he first binds the strong man. And then he will plunder his house.

entries.title: Mark 3:28
segments: Truly I say to you, all sins shall be forgiven to the sons of men, and blasphemies with which they shall blaspheme.

entries.title: Mark 3:29
segments: But he who blasphemes against the Holy Spirit never shall have forgiveness, but is liable to eternal condemnation.

entries.title: Mark 3:30
segments: Because they said, He has an unclean spirit.

entries.title: Mark 3:31
segments: Then His brothers and His mother came. And standing outside, [they] sent to Him, calling Him.

entries.title: Mark 3:32
segments: And the crowd sat about Him, and they said to Him, Behold, Your mother and Your brothers are outside seeking for You.

entries.title: Mark 3:33
segments: And He answered them, saying, Who is My mother, or My brothers?

entries.title: Mark 3:34
segments: And He looked around on those who sat about Him, and said, Behold My mother and My brothers!

entries.title: Mark 3:35
segments: For whoever does the will of God, the same is My brother and My sister and My mother.
